rules.logic: BIOC(MP-036 GlobalProtect Gateway Session Without Preceding Authentication) OR IOC(ipv4 public_ip from the report on panw_ngfw_globalprotect_raw) AND (BIOC(MP-036 RMM Installer Written to Temp and Executed with Relay Arguments) OR BIOC(MP-036 Admin Share Listing and RDP Attempt from One Shell)) AND (BIOC(MP-036 SSH Command Disables ESXi execInstalledOnly) OR BIOC(MP-036 Datastore Browser VMDK Download to Temp) OR BIOC(MP-036 Secretsdump Offline NTDS Parse)) AND (XQL(MP-036 VPN Pool Host RDP and SMB Sessions to Internal Servers) OR ABIOC(MP-036 Rare SSH Session from VPN Pool Host to ESXi Management) OR XQL(MP-036 VPN Pool Host Session to Veeam Backup Service Port 9401)) within 3600s on the same src_ip (private_ip on panw_ngfw_globalprotect_raw; src on panw_ngfw_traffic_raw; agent_ip_addresses on xdr_data) -> one incident naming the exploitation IP(s), the tunnel IP and the hypervisor credential-theft sequence; queried back from xsiam_incidents for MTTD.
